paragraphs.text: translated by
1. I BALM with oil the mighty Raksas-slayer; to the most famous Friend I come for shelter
paragraphs.original: रक्षोहणं वाजिनमा जिघर्मि मित्रं प्रथिष्ठमुप यामि शर्म ।
paragraphs.translit: rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinamā jigharmi mitraṃ prathiṣṭhamupa yāmi śarma |

paragraphs.text: Enkindled, sharpened by our rites, may Agni protect us in the day and night from evil.
paragraphs.original: शिशानो अग्निः क्रतुभिः समिद्धः स नो दिवा स रिषः पातु नक्तम्
paragraphs.translit: śiśāno agniḥ kratubhiḥ samiddhaḥ sa no divā sa riṣaḥ pātu naktam

paragraphs.text: 2. O Jatavedas with the teeth of iron, enkindled with thy flame attack the demons.
paragraphs.original: अयोदंष्ट्रो अर्चिषा यातुधानानुप स्पृश जातवेदः समिद्धः ।
paragraphs.translit: ayodaṃṣṭro arciṣā yātudhānānupa spṛśa jātavedaḥ samiddhaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Seize with thy longue the foolish gods' adorers: rend, put within thy mouth the raw-flesh caters.
paragraphs.original: आ जिह्वया मूरदेवान्रभस्व क्रव्यादो वृक्त्व्यपि धत्स्वासन्
paragraphs.translit: ā jihvayā mūradevānrabhasva kravyādo vṛktvyapi dhatsvāsan

paragraphs.text: 3. Apply thy teeth, the upper and the lower, thou who hast both, enkindled and destroying.
paragraphs.original: उभोभयाविन्नुप धेहि दंष्ट्रा हिंस्रः शिशानोऽवरं परं च ।
paragraphs.translit: ubhobhayāvinnupa dhehi daṃṣṭrā hiṃsraḥ śiśāno'varaṃ paraṃ ca |

paragraphs.text: Roam also in the air, O King, around us, and with thy jaws assail the wicked spirits.
paragraphs.original: उतान्तरिक्षे परि याहि राजञ्जम्भैः सं धेह्यभि यातुधानान्
paragraphs.translit: utāntarikṣe pari yāhi rājañjambhaiḥ saṃ dhehyabhi yātudhānān

paragraphs.text: 4. Bending thy shafts through sacrifices, Agni, whetting their points with song as if with whetstones,
paragraphs.original: यज्ञैरिषूः संनममानो अग्ने वाचा शल्याँ अशनिभिर्दिहानः ।
paragraphs.translit: yajñairiṣūḥ saṃnamamāno agne vācā śalyām̐ aśanibhirdihānaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Pierce to the heart therewith the Yatudhanas, and break their arms uplifted to attack thee.
paragraphs.original: ताभिर्विध्य हृदये यातुधानान्प्रतीचो बाहून्प्रति भङ्ध्येषाम्
paragraphs.translit: tābhirvidhya hṛdaye yātudhānānpratīco bāhūnprati bhaṅdhyeṣām

paragraphs.text: 5. Pierce through the Yatudhana's skin, O Agni; let the destroying dart with fire consume him.
paragraphs.original: अग्ने त्वचं यातुधानस्य भिन्धि हिंस्राशनिर्हरसा हन्त्वेनम् ।
paragraphs.translit: agne tvacaṃ yātudhānasya bhindhi hiṃsrāśanirharasā hantvenam |

paragraphs.text: Rend his joints, Jatavedas, let the cater of flesh, flesh-seeking, track his mangled body.
paragraphs.original: प्र पर्वाणि जातवेदः शृणीहि क्रव्यात्क्रविष्णुर्वि चिनोतु वृक्णम्
paragraphs.translit: pra parvāṇi jātavedaḥ śṛṇīhi kravyātkraviṣṇurvi cinotu vṛkṇam

paragraphs.text: 6. Where now thou seest Agni Jatavedas, one of these demons standing still or roaming,
paragraphs.original: यत्रेदानीं पश्यसि जातवेदस्तिष्ठन्तमग्न उत वा चरन्तम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yatredānīṃ paśyasi jātavedastiṣṭhantamagna uta vā carantam |

paragraphs.text: Or flying on those paths in air's mid region, sharpen the shaft and as an archer pierce him.
paragraphs.original: यद्वान्तरिक्षे पथिभिः पतन्तं तमस्ता विध्य शर्वा शिशानः
paragraphs.translit: yadvāntarikṣe pathibhiḥ patantaṃ tamastā vidhya śarvā śiśānaḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. Tear from the evil spirit, Jatavedas, what he hath seized and with his spears hath captured.
paragraphs.original: उतालब्धं स्पृणुहि जातवेद आलेभानादृष्टिभिर्यातुधानात् ।
paragraphs.translit: utālabdhaṃ spṛṇuhi jātaveda ālebhānādṛṣṭibhiryātudhānāt |

paragraphs.text: Blazing before him strike him down, O Agni; let spotted carrion-eating kites devour him.
paragraphs.original: अग्ने पूर्वो नि जहि शोशुचान आमादः क्ष्विङ्कास्तमदन्त्वेनीः
paragraphs.translit: agne pūrvo ni jahi śośucāna āmādaḥ kṣviṅkāstamadantvenīḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. Here tell this forth, O Agni: whosoever is, he himself, or acteth as, a demon,
paragraphs.original: इह प्र ब्रूहि यतमः सो अग्ने यो यातुधानो य इदं कृणोति ।
paragraphs.translit: iha pra brūhi yatamaḥ so agne yo yātudhāno ya idaṃ kṛṇoti |

paragraphs.text: Him grasp, O thou Most Youthful, with thy fuel. to the Mati-seer's eye give him as booty.
paragraphs.original: तमा रभस्व समिधा यविष्ठ नृचक्षसश्चक्षुषे रन्धयैनम्
paragraphs.translit: tamā rabhasva samidhā yaviṣṭha nṛcakṣasaścakṣuṣe randhayainam

paragraphs.text: 9. With keen glance guard the sacrifice, O Agni: thou Sage, conduct it onward to the Vasus.
paragraphs.original: तीक्ष्णेनाग्ने चक्षुषा रक्ष यज्ञं प्राञ्चं वसुभ्यः प्र णय प्रचेतः ।
paragraphs.translit: tīkṣṇenāgne cakṣuṣā rakṣa yajñaṃ prāñcaṃ vasubhyaḥ pra ṇaya pracetaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Let not the fiends, O Man-beholder, harm thee burning against the Raksasas to slay them.
paragraphs.original: हिंस्रं रक्षांस्यभि शोशुचानं मा त्वा दभन्यातुधाना नृचक्षः
paragraphs.translit: hiṃsraṃ rakṣāṃsyabhi śośucānaṃ mā tvā dabhanyātudhānā nṛcakṣaḥ

paragraphs.text: 10. Look on the fiend mid men, as Man-beholder: rend thou his three extremities in pieces.
paragraphs.original: नृचक्षा रक्षः परि पश्य विक्षु तस्य त्रीणि प्रति शृणीह्यग्रा ।
paragraphs.translit: nṛcakṣā rakṣaḥ pari paśya vikṣu tasya trīṇi prati śṛṇīhyagrā |

paragraphs.text: Demolish with thy flame his ribs, O Agni, the Yatudhana's root destroy thou triply.
paragraphs.original: तस्याग्ने पृष्टीर्हरसा शृणीहि त्रेधा मूलं यातुधानस्य वृश्च
paragraphs.translit: tasyāgne pṛṣṭīrharasā śṛṇīhi tredhā mūlaṃ yātudhānasya vṛśca

paragraphs.text: 11. Thrice, Agni, let thy noose surround the demon who with his falsehood injures Holy Order.
paragraphs.original: त्रिर्यातुधानः प्रसितिं त एत्वृतं यो अग्ने अनृतेन हन्ति ।
paragraphs.translit: triryātudhānaḥ prasitiṃ ta etvṛtaṃ yo agne anṛtena hanti |

paragraphs.text: Loud roaring with thy flame, O Jatavedas, crush him and cast him down before the singer.
paragraphs.original: तमर्चिषा स्फूर्जयञ्जातवेदः समक्षमेनं गृणते नि वृङ्धि
paragraphs.translit: tamarciṣā sphūrjayañjātavedaḥ samakṣamenaṃ gṛṇate ni vṛṅdhi

paragraphs.text: 12. Lead thou the worshipper that eye, O Agni, wherewith thou lookest on the hoof-armed demon.
paragraphs.original: तदग्ने चक्षुः प्रति धेहि रेभे शफारुजं येन पश्यसि यातुधानम् ।
paragraphs.translit: tadagne cakṣuḥ prati dhehi rebhe śaphārujaṃ yena paśyasi yātudhānam |

paragraphs.text: With light celestial in Atharvan's manner burn up the foot who ruins truth with falsehood.
paragraphs.original: अथर्ववज्ज्योतिषा दैव्येन सत्यं धूर्वन्तमचितं न्योष
paragraphs.translit: atharvavajjyotiṣā daivyena satyaṃ dhūrvantamacitaṃ nyoṣa

paragraphs.text: 13. Agni, what curse the pair this day have uttered, what heated word the worshippers have spoken,
paragraphs.original: यदग्ने अद्य मिथुना शपातो यद्वाचस्तृष्टं जनयन्त रेभाः ।
paragraphs.translit: yadagne adya mithunā śapāto yadvācastṛṣṭaṃ janayanta rebhāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Each arrowy taunt sped from the angry spirit,-pierce to the heart therewith the Yatudhanas.
paragraphs.original: मन्योर्मनसः शरव्या जायते या तया विध्य हृदये यातुधानान्
paragraphs.translit: manyormanasaḥ śaravyā jāyate yā tayā vidhya hṛdaye yātudhānān

paragraphs.text: 14. With fervent heat exterminate the demons; destroy the fiends with burning flame, O Agni.
paragraphs.original: परा शृणीहि तपसा यातुधानान्पराग्ने रक्षो हरसा शृणीहि ।
paragraphs.translit: parā śṛṇīhi tapasā yātudhānānparāgne rakṣo harasā śṛṇīhi |

paragraphs.text: Destroy with fire the foolish gods' adorers; blaze and destroy the insatiable monsters.
paragraphs.original: परार्चिषा मूरदेवाञ्छृणीहि परासुतृपो अभि शोशुचानः
paragraphs.translit: parārciṣā mūradevāñchṛṇīhi parāsutṛpo abhi śośucānaḥ

paragraphs.text: 15. May Gods destroy this day the evil-doer may each hot curse of his return and blast him.
paragraphs.original: पराद्य देवा वृजिनं शृणन्तु प्रत्यगेनं शपथा यन्तु तृष्टाः ।
paragraphs.translit: parādya devā vṛjinaṃ śṛṇantu pratyagenaṃ śapathā yantu tṛṣṭāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Let arrows pierce the liar in his vitals, and Visva's net enclose the Yatudhana.
paragraphs.original: वाचास्तेनं शरव ऋच्छन्तु मर्मन्विश्वस्यैतु प्रसितिं यातुधानः
paragraphs.translit: vācāstenaṃ śarava ṛcchantu marmanviśvasyaitu prasitiṃ yātudhānaḥ

paragraphs.text: 16. The fiend who smears himself with flesh of cattle, with flesh of horses and of human bodies,
paragraphs.original: यः पौरुषेयेण क्रविषा समङ्क्ते यो अश्व्येन पशुना यातुधानः ।
paragraphs.translit: yaḥ pauruṣeyeṇa kraviṣā samaṅkte yo aśvyena paśunā yātudhānaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Who steals the milch-cow's milk away, O Agni,-tear off the heads of such with fiery fury.
paragraphs.original: यो अघ्न्याया भरति क्षीरमग्ने तेषां शीर्षाणि हरसापि वृश्च
paragraphs.translit: yo aghnyāyā bharati kṣīramagne teṣāṃ śīrṣāṇi harasāpi vṛśca

paragraphs.text: 17. The cow gives milk each year, O Man-regarder: let not the Yatudhana ever taste it.
paragraphs.original: संवत्सरीणं पय उस्रियायास्तस्य माशीद्यातुधानो नृचक्षः ।
paragraphs.translit: saṃvatsarīṇaṃ paya usriyāyāstasya māśīdyātudhāno nṛcakṣaḥ |

paragraphs.text: If one would glut him with the biesting, Agni, pierce with thy flame his vitals as he meets thee.
paragraphs.original: पीयूषमग्ने यतमस्तितृप्सात्तं प्रत्यञ्चमर्चिषा विध्य मर्मन्
paragraphs.translit: pīyūṣamagne yatamastitṛpsāttaṃ pratyañcamarciṣā vidhya marman

paragraphs.text: 18. Let the fiends drink the poison of the cattle; may Aditi cast off the evildoers.
paragraphs.original: विषं गवां यातुधानाः पिबन्त्वा वृश्च्यन्तामदितये दुरेवाः ।
paragraphs.translit: viṣaṃ gavāṃ yātudhānāḥ pibantvā vṛścyantāmaditaye durevāḥ |

paragraphs.text: May the God Savitar give them up to ruin, and be their share of plants and herbs denied them.
paragraphs.original: परैनान्देवः सविता ददातु परा भागमोषधीनां जयन्ताम्
paragraphs.translit: paraināndevaḥ savitā dadātu parā bhāgamoṣadhīnāṃ jayantām

paragraphs.text: 19. Agni, from days of old thou slayest demons: never shall Raksasas in fight o'ercome thee.
paragraphs.original: सनादग्ने मृणसि यातुधानान्न त्वा रक्षांसि पृतनासु जिग्युः ।
paragraphs.translit: sanādagne mṛṇasi yātudhānānna tvā rakṣāṃsi pṛtanāsu jigyuḥ |

paragraphs.text: Burn up the foolish ones, the flesh-devourers: let none of them escape thine heavenly arrow.
paragraphs.original: अनु दह सहमूरान्क्रव्यादो मा ते हेत्या मुक्षत दैव्यायाः
paragraphs.translit: anu daha sahamūrānkravyādo mā te hetyā mukṣata daivyāyāḥ

paragraphs.text: 20. Guard us, O Agni, from above and under, protect us from behind us and before us;
paragraphs.original: त्वं नो अग्ने अधरादुदक्तात्त्वं पश्चादुत रक्षा पुरस्तात् ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ no agne adharādudaktāttvaṃ paścāduta rakṣā purastāt |

paragraphs.text: And may thy flames, most fierce and never wasting, glowing with fervent heat, consume the sinner.
paragraphs.original: प्रति ते ते अजरासस्तपिष्ठा अघशंसं शोशुचतो दहन्तु
paragraphs.translit: prati te te ajarāsastapiṣṭhā aghaśaṃsaṃ śośucato dahantu

paragraphs.text: 21. From rear, from front, from under, from above us, O King, protect us as a Sage with wisdom.
paragraphs.original: पश्चात्पुरस्तादधरादुदक्तात्कविः काव्येन परि पाहि राजन् ।
paragraphs.translit: paścātpurastādadharādudaktātkaviḥ kāvyena pari pāhi rājan |

paragraphs.text: Guard to old age thy friend, O Friend, Eternal: O Agni, as Immortal, guard us mortals.
paragraphs.original: सखे सखायमजरो जरिम्णेऽग्ने मर्ताँ अमर्त्यस्त्वं नः
paragraphs.translit: sakhe sakhāyamajaro jarimṇe'gne martām̐ amartyastvaṃ naḥ

paragraphs.text: 22. We set thee round us as a fort, victorious Agni, thee a Sage,
paragraphs.original: परि त्वाग्ने पुरं वयं विप्रं सहस्य धीमहि ।
paragraphs.translit: pari tvāgne puraṃ vayaṃ vipraṃ sahasya dhīmahi |

paragraphs.text: Of hero lineage, day by day, destroyer of our treacherous foes.
paragraphs.original: धृषद्वर्णं दिवेदिवे हन्तारं भङ्गुरावताम्
paragraphs.translit: dhṛṣadvarṇaṃ divedive hantāraṃ bhaṅgurāvatām

paragraphs.text: 23. Burn with thy poison turned against the treacherous brood of Raksasas,
paragraphs.original: विषेण भङ्गुरावतः प्रति ष्म रक्षसो दह ।
paragraphs.translit: viṣeṇa bhaṅgurāvataḥ prati ṣma rakṣaso daha |

paragraphs.text: O Agni, with thy sharpened glow, with lances armed with points of flame.
paragraphs.original: अग्ने तिग्मेन शोचिषा तपुरग्राभिरृष्टिभिः
paragraphs.translit: agne tigmena śociṣā tapuragrābhirṛṣṭibhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 24. Burn thou the paired Kimidins, burn, Agni, the Yatudhana pairs.
paragraphs.original: प्रत्यग्ने मिथुना दह यातुधाना किमीदिना ।
paragraphs.translit: pratyagne mithunā daha yātudhānā kimīdinā |

paragraphs.text: I sharpen thee, Infallible, with hymns. O Sage, be vigilant.
paragraphs.original: सं त्वा शिशामि जागृह्यदब्धं विप्र मन्मभिः
paragraphs.translit: saṃ tvā śiśāmi jāgṛhyadabdhaṃ vipra manmabhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 25. Shoot forth, O Agni, with thy flame demolish them on every side.
paragraphs.original: प्रत्यग्ने हरसा हरः शृणीहि विश्वतः प्रति ।
paragraphs.translit: pratyagne harasā haraḥ śṛṇīhi viśvataḥ prati |

paragraphs.text: Break thou the Yatudhana's strength, the vigour of the Raksasa.
paragraphs.original: यातुधानस्य रक्षसो बलं वि रुज वीर्यम्
paragraphs.translit: yātudhānasya rakṣaso balaṃ vi ruja vīryam
